description: Check whether a custom deployment is wired up for git-push auto-deploy. Returns the git url, branch, the mode (github one-click | manual generic | none), whether the webhook is active, and the payload URL the provider posts to. Use before calling `impreza_git_webhook_connect` to confirm the deployment was created with a git source (mode=dockerfile + git_url) — image-mode and manifest-mode deploys can't auto-deploy from git.

deployment_id.description: The dpl_... id of a custom deployment.

name: impreza_git_webhook_status
